sessions.name: pinned-prefix/seed/001-round-ties
sources:
root = Card([
  CardHeader("Round ties"),
  KVList([
    {label: "half", value: @Round(0.5)},
    {label: "neg-half", value: @Round(-0.5)},
    {label: "one-half", value: @Round(1.5)},
    {label: "neg-one-half", value: @Round(-1.5)},
    {label: "two-half", value: @Round(2.5)},
    {label: "neg-two-half", value: @Round(-2.5)},
    {label: "eps-below-half", value: @Round(0.49999999999999994)},
    {label: "neg-third", value: @Round(-0.3)},
    {label: "neg-two-thirds", value: @Round(-0.7)},
    {label: "pow2-half", value: @Round(4503599627370496.5)},
    {label: "d2-tie", value: @Round(1.005, 2)},
    {label: "d2-neg-tie", value: @Round(-1.005, 2)},
    {label: "d1-tie", value: @Round(0.05, 1)},
    {label: "d1-neg-tie", value: @Round(-0.15, 1)},
    {label: "d-neg", value: @Round(1234.5678, -2)},
    {label: "str", value: "" + @Round(-0.5)}
  ], "ROUND")
])

sessions.name: pinned-prefix/seed/004-string-hazards
sources:
$name = " padded "
root = Card([
  CardHeader("String hazards", "sub\ttab"),
  KVList([
    {label: "escapes", value: "q\"b\\s\nn\rr\ttAuA"},
    {label: "nbsp", value: "a b"},
    {label: "bom", value: "﻿head"},
    {label: "combining", value: "é"},
    {label: "astral", value: "🎉🚀"},
    {label: "u2028", value: "a b"},
    {label: "u0085", value: "ab"},
    {label: "bad-escape", value: "keep \q and \x41 literal"},
    {label: "concat", value: "n=" + 1 + 2},
    {label: "coerce-nbsp", value: " 12.5 " * 1},
    {label: "coerce-u2028", value: " 1e3 " * 1},
    {label: "coerce-empty", value: "" * 1},
    {label: "trimmed", value: $name},
    {label: "ternary", value: $name ? "yes" : "no"}
  ], "STRINGS")
])

sessions.name: pinned-prefix/088-prototype-member-access
sources:
$obj = { a: 1 }
$arr = [1, 2]
card = TextContent("hi")
root = Card([
  TextContent($obj.toString + "|" + $obj.constructor + "|" + $obj.hasOwnProperty),
  TextContent("arr=" + $arr.constructor),
  TextContent("n=" + $obj.toString.name + " l=" + $obj.toString.length),
  TextContent("p=" + $obj.__proto__.constructor + " q=" + $obj.__proto__.__proto__),
  TextContent("el=" + card.typeName + "/" + card.partial + "/" + card.type),
  KVList([{ key: "fn", value: $obj.toString }])
])

sessions.name: pinned-prefix/090-sort-ascii-collation
sources:
labels = ["a-b", "ab", " s", "a b c", "a.b", "[object Object]", "co-op", "coop", "A", "a", "-x", "_x", "ab ", "a b"]
root = Card([
  CardHeader("ascii collation"),
  TextContent("all=" + @Sort(labels)),
  TextContent("p1=" + @Sort([" s", "1"])),
  TextContent("p2=" + @Sort(["-0", "[object Object]"])),
  TextContent("p3=" + @Sort(["a-b", "a.b"]))
])

root = Card([
  CardHeader("String hazards", "sub\ttab"),
  KVList([
    {label: "escapes", value: "q\"b\\s\nn\rr\ttAuA"},
    {label: "nbsp", value: "a b"},
    {label: "bom", value: "﻿head"},
    {label: "combining", value: "é"},
    {label: "astral", value: "🎉🚀"},
    {label: "u2028", value: "{ b"},
    {label: "u0085", value: "ab"},
    {label: "bad-escape", value: "keep \q and \x41 literal"},
    {label: "concat", value: "n=" + 1 + 2},
    {label: "coerce-nbsp", value: " 12.5 " * 1},
    {label: "coerce-u2028", value: " 1e3 " * 1},
    {label: "coerce-empty", value: "" * 1},
    {label: "trimmed", value: $name},
    {label: "ternary", value: $name ? "yes" : "no"}
  ], "STRINGS")
])
